name: Numina
positioning: Enterprise services, software, intelligence and blockchain across the global economy
mission: Unify agents, software, code, assets, liquidity, verification and evidence through one governed system.

dimensions.agents: Identity, delegated authority and bounded intent
dimensions.softwareAndCode: Applications, integrations, plugins and verifiable releases
dimensions.blockchain: Numina network connectivity and evidence of confirmed on-chain activity
dimensions.moneyAndAssets: One Numina-native NUSD projection, designated funding sources and provider-reported assets
dimensions.liquidity: Funding plans, asset allocation and confirmed settlement evidence
dimensions.time: Policy expiry, ordered journal events and evidence timestamps
dimensions.space: Network, system, resource and jurisdiction scope
dimensions.verificationAndEvidence: Policy decisions, human approvals and cryptographically bound provenance
